text: My main symptom is Progressive difficulty walking. I also have Urinary incontinence, Slurred speech, Rigidity in limbs, Mild hand tremor, Orthostatic hypotension.

text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. No known chronic diseases. Social history: Occasionally consumes alcohol. Non-smoker. Works as a bank clerk.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on the combination of progressive gait disturbance, urinary incontinence, speech difficulties, and neck fullness, I am highly suspicious of cervical myelopathy due to a compressive lesion in the spinal cord.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Myelopathy secondary to Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy
